reviews.text:
Cool Tech always has Great Service.  Ben even came on thanksgiving day to fix a heating problem.
Andria is very nice, professional, and very efficient.   I have been using Cool Tech for at least 10 years for my business and my home.

I recently had a fantastic experience with a technician named Ramiro who replaced my AC unit after it had stopped working. Setting up the appointment was incredibly straightforward, and I appreciated how accommodating the scheduling process was.

The quality of service was truly exceptional, deserving of all the praise. What also stood out was that the pricing was quite reasonable, which is a definite bonus when it comes to home repairs.

World class customer service.

Ben was timely and explained the issues to repair.
Part has to be ordered prior to scheduling repair.
A new review will be added once all services are completed.

Ben has been to my home for tune ups before and always does a great job. This is the first time I had a tune up done for my Daiken mini split I had Cool Tech install a couple seasons ago. I kept hearing an air surge and funny noise from in the indoor unit in my bedroom. The refrigerant level was in good and everything was clean except the blower wheel. The blower wheel can't be easily cleaned or accessed. I looked at some You Tube videos and this is a common problem and all brands of mini splits

Your Service Tech, "Harold" was on time, courteous & knowledgable.
He got the refrigerant recharge job done quickly & w/o any surprise incidents.
I am well satisfied.
They arrived fast and found the problem immediately. Should be fixed in a few days.   They came today with the new compressor. We now have air conditioning again.

The A/C units were originally installed by Cooltech (two units total), and overall, they’ve been problem-free. I’ve been satisfied with their performance. When I recently had an issue, the technician arrived within the expected time window and was prompt and courteous.

Given the warm weather, I had placed a fan and knee cushion in the attic in preparation. With my maintenance background, I suspected the issue was the blower motor in the attic, which the technician confirmed.

The only issue I h
Ben Sutton is great!! Very reliable and honest and explains any issues we might have.
Having done business with Cool Tech for well over 15 years...each time; total satisfaction!
The technician was very professional and knowledgeable. He did a wonderful job. I highly recommend his services! As always they came right out and it was the weekend.

I have used Cool Tech Air-Conditioning & Heating for many years, for 2 different houses. After moving to another home outside of Arlington, I continued to use them because they have always done a great job for me. One of the main things I like about them is their stability. From their owner, Jon, to all of their technicians, they’ve all been there for several years. When workers don’t move around, and stay with the same company for several years, I think that’s a great sign that you’ve found a g

Called at 5:45 on a Tuesday afternoon when my AC stopped working. Ben was at my door in about an hour and had it diagnosed in a few minutes. We needed a part and he said he would get an estimate to me in the morning… 8:06am I had the estimate and approved the work and Ben was back in an hour or so. He had the parts needed, quickly got them installed, cleaned parts of my AC that had not been cleaned in a while… and checked to make sure it was working properly. I was impressed so I signed up for t

Cool Tech Mechanical provided excellent customer service.  Good communication in timing of service, the technician, Ben S., answered all of my questions and he was honest.  A neighbor who has used Cool Tech for years recommended that I call them after another company told me that I needed to buy a $31,000 unit because the industry was moving to a new coolant!  I highly recommend Cool Tech and will be calling them again to service my unit.

Kacy arrived promptly, was quick to identify and correct the problem and thorough in making sure the problem was fully resolved.  On top of that, there was no charge for the service call since a routine system check had been performed just a week prior.  I have always been impressed with Cool Tech's service and this experience certainly reinforced my opinion.
My newborn baby is finally able to sleep now that Jerred came and fixed our AC He was quick and efficient full of knowledge answered all of my questions made me feel like family
Experience shows and I am very happy with the repair. Appointment set for next day after I called.

The cool tech staff is always prompt and ready to help us with any concerns and issues. We’ve used them for years and are pleased with their customer service. I’ve worked with Ben a lot and he is always helpful and also well experienced!

My experience with Cool Tech Mechanical was great from the start to the completion of repairs. Even with it being the 'busy season' they were able to send the technician the same day I called for service. Ben S. arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the problem and completed repairs in under a half hour. With this professional service, they've become my "go-to" HVAC service company the next time I need one.

Kacy Horn was my technician. Excellent service on the system Cool Tech installed 13 years ago. He was professional and polite and let me know what they were going to do and reviewed what they did after the work was completed. Made me aware of the agreed on service call price before work began. Highly recommend this company and kudos to Kacy.

We have used CoolTech for many years now. They are always professional and courteous. They show up quickly whenever we have a problem which always seems to be right before a big weather event. They really are the best at what they do!
Always a great company: punctual and consistently priced.

Excellent company to deal with. Love that the communicate via text if that's what you want, even to set appt. Came out the very next day after I contacted them for an annual check up. Tech Harold Berry went above and beyond and then gave me very helpful maintenance tips. Will use Cool Tech again.

Did not show up for service call !!!!, I called and made service call, it was for $99.95for the next day from 1pm-5pm, I called around 1:23pm to ask if the tech would call when he is on his way, I was told yes, well, no show no call !!!! What a great company, not !!!!! Again, I don't know  what are you responding a bout, I called about my system that both AC/ heater works at the same time!!! , look at picture. a simple apology will okay.

Cool Tech Mechanical has been tremendous with there support and knowledge. When I first called Cool tech 2 years ago it was after haveing 3 different local HVAC companies come out to diagnosis an issue I was having. 1 issue but 3 diffrent diagnosis all saying a new $20,000 unit was needed. But due to electronic componet shortage new units were back ordered. I called Cool Tech to come out and quote me on a new unit. The owner said they would come out and check the system and see what issue I was

We have used Cool Tech Mechanical for all of our heating and cooling service needs for several years. Also, we bought a new Trane system from them last year. They are very responsive, responsible, reliable, honest, and professional. A great company and great people to work with.

Cooltech Mechanical has been taking care of our HVAC for about 10 years. They've been honest and relatively inexpensive.  (No HVAC repair is truly inexpensive.) They're also very responsive. (They've been to our house on short notice on both Memorial Day and Independence Day - not the same year - to get us cool again as soon as possible.)

We recently had a great experience with Cool Tech Mechanical.  Our neighbor, who is a realtor, had used them before and highly recommended them.

From the initial contact in setting up the appointment with Tammy, they were super friendly and responsive.  Ben Segundo did a fantastic job fixing our problem and it wasn't an easy one.  Super nice guy and really knew his stuff.

Glad to have an AC company that does a good job and is honest.   Will absolutely be calling them in the future.
The technician, Harold did a great job. We’re always pleased with the work.  I highly recommend CoolTech.  Ask for Harold!
Arrived on time.  Serviced the three units and will be back to replace a part on one of them.

Outstanding service! We discovered  a problem on Saturday afternoon; called the emergency line; Kacy arrived less than 30 minutes after our call. He worked diligently, always letting us know what he was doing. We could not be more pleased! Thank you very much!

The tech, Ben, was knowledgeable and a pleasure to work with. My only issue is the HVAC unit is only 6 months old and at first they wanted to charge me for a service call and to put  R410A , 3 lbs, worth back in a brand new unit.  I am not paying for warranty work and it is surely not our fault that a sealed system is leaking freon. They said they would be back out early next week to finish the repairs.  I will update my review once this occurs

Awoke to one of our AC units not working properly. Contacted CoolTech on a friend’s recommendation. Got us on their schedule right away for afternoon service. Tech and apprentice arrived and quickly diagnosed our problem. Thankfully nothing major. They had the parts onboard and got us up and running quickly. All contact was friendly, responsive and professional. Love their text alerts, receipts and mapping.
Would definitely recommend and will use again.

Top tier service with affordable prices.  I placed a service request through Cool Tech’s website 7:30 Thurs nite when A/C quit.  They had it fixed by 3p Friday! Ben demonstrated the bad capacitor, quickly replaced it and checked system! Thanks!
Great service. Harold B is a tech with the company and he is a joy to work with. Honest, fast and knowledgeable, I highly recommend Cool Tech Mechanical for your HVAC needed.

Ben from Cool Tech arrived promptly, diagnosed the cooling system problem quickly, and restored our A/C functionality.  He was courteous, professional, friendly, and was careful to keep our home clean.

A/C quit on 100 degree day. Contacted cool tech on neighbor recommendation at 730 AM. Promised to have someone there that day. Tech H showed up in 2 hours. Fixed the problem in less than an hour. It’s an older unit. We got no upgrade or sales push. Just great service and information. The price was very fair. Made us seniors and our pets very happy. Best HVAC experience ever.
Cool Tech does great work. Really appreciate the quick response diagnosis and repair.

I called Cool Tech this morning, and
told her that something was wrong with my thermostat, She told me someone will come out before noon and they were here before noon!
The Tech fixed the problem right away.
I bought two air conditioner and heating units from Cool Tech five years ago and honestly they have the best customer service that I have ever dealt with I would recommend anyone going to them.

Found Cool Tech on the Good Contractors list.  We received a text with our techs photo and estimated arrival.  He was professional and prepared our AC for the season.  He did not try and “sell” us extra services.  Pleased with our first service call for preventative maintenance

Your technician did a great job servicing my furnace, as usual. Courteous, knowledgeable,  friendly and very helpful!!.
Looking forward to your service next Spring😀!!
Jim

Cool Tech Mechanical sent a technician within 4 hrs of my call, on a day when the outside temp was 100°. Ben was extremely professional, knowledgeable and proficient. He resolved my AC issue in less than 30 minutes. Highly recommended

Gave us an honest evaluation and good price. We got a new Heater and AC, replacing a 30 year old system. Apparently there was an issue with installation and we had to call an emergency service through another company. Cool Tech paid the bill for the emergency service and came back to make sure the issue was resolved at no additional fee. I find them very trust worthy and reliable. We would highly recommend them and will be calling them if we need anything else.

Last week I had to change my AC unit and I have to say that Cool Tech did an amazing job, I want to thanks specially Mr Jon to help me with all the process very quickly and efficiently.
I will recommend Cool Tech 100%

Cooltech was a pleasure to work with. They were professional, on time, and answered all of my questions regarding the system. The installation was faster than I expected and the price was better than the competitors (I had 6 or 7 different companies come out). There was no mess of any kind left in my home and they did their due diligence to ensure everything was in working order before leaving. Jon even followed up with me later after the installation. Would definitely recommend them.

Great staff. Jon gave me a good estimate and went over everything they would do. His crew installed a complete unit in half a day, and left everything clean. Ben programmed my wifi thermostat to work off my phone. That has been so handy to have. I highly recommend Cool Tech Mechanical to anyone needing a new a/c or heating unit or repair work on their existing unit. You won't regret it.

We have been Cool Tech customers for several years. They helped keep our old unit going as long as possible & when it came time for a whole new unit, they made the whole process so easy & affordable that we wished we hadn't waited so long for the new unit. Cool Tech is always reliable & honest & I wouldn't trust any other company with my heating & cooling system.

Everyone I have spoken with and had services performed by in my home has always been super great!!! Friendly, knowledgeable, prompt, and confident. I appreciate Kacy’s detailed/meticulous service maintenance, explanation of what’s going on with the equipment, and suggestions to keep everything running well. He is personable and is kind to my protective (initially barking) dog who made friends with him! I highly recommend this company.
The owner and service technicians are honest and are always a

Our downstairs air conditioner quit cooling. They came out same day we called and quickly diagnosed and repaired our issue. The technician was courteous and on-time. They didn’t gouge us on price. I highly recommend this company for service!

We had Cool Tech Mechanical come to replace a programmable AC system. Jon Kalp came over for detailed  estimate after their tech came over first time. Originally we thought we had to replace the AC units. Jon was very professional and honest and said that was not the case and we replace only the wireless units. They installed new system.  They came on time, did what they said at a fair price. I would highly recommend.

I'm very happy to write a review for companies I use who are honest, reliable and do their job well.
Cool Tech Mechanical is such a company. I have had two new units put in by them. Couple of days after the install, Jon, the owner called to make sure all went well. I actually told him this last unit was a little loud, he sent the tech out same day to adjust the blower setting and also to deliver a year supply of free filters he'd ordered for me.
